question: Can I get a refund on my annual plan after two months?
current: Yes. Annual plans cancelled after the first 30 days are refunded pro rata for the unused months (Refund policy).
archive: Unfortunately annual plans are non-refundable (Refund policy).

question: How many days do I have to ask for a refund?
current: You can get a full refund within 30 days of purchase on any paid plan (Refund policy).
archive: You have 14 days from purchase, and only for monthly plans (Refund policy).

question: How much does the Pro plan cost?
current: Pro is $49 per user per month, or 20% less with annual billing (Plans and pricing).
archive: Pro is $39 per user per month and includes 10 projects (Plans and pricing).

question: What is the cheapest plan and what does it include?
current: Starter at $19 per user per month, with 3 projects (Plans and pricing).
archive: Starter at $12 per user per month, with 1 project (Plans and pricing).

question: Do I need Enterprise to use SSO?
current: No. SAML and OIDC SSO are included on Pro and Enterprise (Single sign-on).
archive: Yes, SSO is only available on the Enterprise plan (Single sign-on).

question: Can we use Microsoft Entra ID for single sign-on?
current: Yes. Entra ID is supported, along with Okta, Google Workspace and any SAML 2.0 provider (Single sign-on).
archive: No, Okta is the only supported identity provider (Single sign-on).

question: What is the API rate limit on the Pro plan?
current: 1,000 requests per minute per workspace on Pro (API rate limits).
archive: 300 requests per minute per API key on Pro (API rate limits).

question: Do you offer an uptime SLA with service credits?
current: Enterprise has a contractual 99.99% SLA with service credits; Starter and Pro target 99.95% (Uptime and SLA).
archive: There is no contractual SLA or service credits; the target is 99.9% (Uptime and SLA).

question: Is support available on weekends for Pro customers?
current: Yes. Pro and Enterprise have 24/7 chat and email support (Support hours and channels).
archive: No, support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 US Eastern (Support hours and channels).

question: How long until my data is deleted after I close my workspace?
current: Data is permanently removed within 30 days, including backups (Deleting your account).
archive: Data is removed within 90 days after you email support (Deleting your account).

question: How do I export all my projects?
current: Go to Settings > Data > Export; a download link valid for 7 days is emailed when ready (Exporting your data).
archive: Go to Settings > Data > Export; a download link valid for 7 days is emailed when ready (Exporting your data).

question: Is there an API for data exports?
current: Yes, GET /v2/exports returns the same data as the export screen (Exporting your data).
archive: The help center describes exporting from Settings > Data > Export; I couldn't find an export API (Exporting your data).
